changelog:
Initial release of discussion-cohesion-diagnosis skill.

- Diagnoses cohesion in the Discussion section of English psychology research papers.
- Assesses both local-level cohesion (connectives, reference chains, citation integration) and global-level narrative thread (controlling idea, forward motion, take-home message).
- Provides rubric and diagnostic signals for identifying common cohesion and narrative-flow issues.
- Does not generate or rewrite text; only offers objective diagnostic feedback.
- Triggers on relevant prompts such as "check Discussion cohesion" or "narrative flow check".
